Stroke admissions typically involved longer hospital stays than heart attack admissions. In 2022–23, the median length of stay was 9 days for stroke (interquartile range 3–18 days), compared with 6 days for heart attack (interquartile range 3–9 days). These are planning indicators rather than direct measures of care quality: they reflect patient severity, survival, rehabilitation needs and the availability of discharge and step-down care.
